test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

15, 15, 17, 51, 55, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 15 × 1 = 15
 
• 15 + 2 = 17
 
• 17 × 3 = 51
 
• 51 + 4 = 55
 
• 55 × 5 = 275

Hence, '**275**' is the correct answer.
